This original Java factory binds a parent carrier's formal independently of the
direct child seeds and invariant result formal. The frozen observer checks both
seed identities, mutable traces, original parent reads, alternate/null/parent
returns, constructor publication and partial final-field writes, failures and
full generic reflection through direct, frozen, reflective and method-handle
calls. It makes no input/returned-parent identity inference. The provider may
remain frozen in a dependency JAR.
